title: Day 796: Gunmen Hit Rehab Center, Event Hall and Home in Three Culiacán Attacks
detail: Within hours of each other on Saturday, September 26, 2026, gunmen carried out three separate shooting attacks in Culiacán. At a drug rehabilitation center on Calle Viviano Dávalos in the Revolución neighborhood, Liam Yan 'N', a 42-year-old Chinese national, was wounded by gunfire and taken to hospital by Red Cross paramedics. At the Salón Capistrano event hall on Calle Camario in the Rafael Buelna neighborhood, gunmen fired directly at the facade and doors before fleeing, causing no injuries. At a private residence in the Adolfo López Mateos neighborhood, bullets struck the facade, doors and windows and pierced a stationary LP gas tank, triggering a leak that the Culiacán Fire Department brought under control. The Mexican Army and State Police cordoned off all three sites; state forensic teams collected ballistic evidence and dozens of spent shell casings.

title: Day 796: Man Shot Dead in Villas del Humaya, North Culiacán
detail: At approximately 5:31 PM on Saturday, September 26, 2026, residents reported gunfire on a closed street at the intersection of Villa de Tres Ríos and Villa Sinaloa, in the Villas del Humaya subdivision (Villa Fontana sector), north Culiacán. Security personnel found an unidentified man of robust build, wearing a black shirt, jeans and black sneakers, lying face-down with multiple gunshot wounds; he had no vital signs on arrival. Mexican Army personnel, SSPC officials and Red Cross paramedics secured the scene while the State General Directorate of Forensic Investigation collected evidence and evidence suggested he may have been abducted before the shooting.
